title: Berge's theorem on maximum matchings
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph and let $M$ be a matching in $G$. Then $M$ is a maximum matching if and only if $G$ contains no $M$-augmenting path.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph
M is a matching in G
replaced:
Thm 5.1 (Berge): a matching is maximum iff there is no augmenting path.

(Berge, 1957)  A matching $M$ in $G$ is a maximum matching if
and only if $G$ contains no $M$-augmenting path.
